description: A creative director’s pick: an unexpected but tasteful direction for the brief or the design (one of Paletoo’s art directions with a twist, in a style recipe the design has not worn yet) and one line on why — say it to the person. With a design: a new artboard beside it (live if open); otherwise a new design (counts as one).

avoid.description: directions and recipes already shown (ids), to pick another

brief.description: the idea, in the person’s words; e.g. «opening of my yoga studio»

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

eyebrow.description: the small line near the headline (a date, a tag)

headline.description: the big line, 2–6 words (\n for a line break)

name: surprise_me
title: Surprise me
